units.source_text: 太吉郎的店铺之所以没赶时髦，几乎保留原来的样子而未加改装，固然是由于主人的性格，另一方面，恐怕也是因为批发生意不那么兴隆吧。

en.t: The reason Taikichiro's shop had not followed the latest fashion, remaining almost as it had always been without any remodeling, was of course partly the owner's character; but on the other hand, it was probably also because the wholesale business was not doing all that well.
